title: Robustness Starts with the Objective: Designing and Certifying Robust LLM-Generated Heuristics
abstract: arXiv:2611.00504v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLMs are increasingly used to design heuristics for computer systems. However, most synthesis frameworks evaluate candidates by their average performance, which can mask severe regressions on specific workloads. Even adding adversarial training inputs doesn't eliminate these regressions, and percentile objectives (e.g., optimizing for the 95th percentile) overlook how severe regressions can be beyond the selected threshold.   We present TAILOR, a framework that guides LLM synthesis using the Conditional Value at Risk (CVaR) of the cost difference between each candidate and an existing baseline on the same workload. This paired CVaR measures the average difference over the worst fraction of workloads. We show that a negative paired CVaR guarantees improvements in both average performance and tail optimality gap relative to the unknown optimum, without ever computing that optimum. translated_title: 鲁棒性始于目标函数：设计并认证鲁棒的LLM生成启发式算法
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地被用于为计算机系统设计启发式算法。然而，大多数合成框架通过平均性能来评估候选方案，这可能掩盖在特定工作负载上的严重性能退化。即使添加对抗性训练输入也无法消除这些退化，而百分位数目标（例如优化第95百分位数）则忽略了超过所选阈值后退化可能达到的严重程度。我们提出了TAILOR，一个利用条件风险价值（CVaR）来指导LLM合成的框架，该CVaR基于每个候选方案与现有基线在同一工作负载上的成本差异。这种配对CVaR度量的是在最差一部分工作负载上的平均差异。我们证明，负的配对CVaR能够在无需计算未知最优解的情况下，保证在平均性能和相对未知最优解的尾部最优性差距两方面均取得改进。我们发现TAILOR实现了最佳的均值-尾部权衡……
tldr: TAILOR框架利用候选方案与现有基线在同一工作负载上成本差异的条件风险价值（配对CVaR）来指导LLM合成启发式算法，负的配对CVaR可以在无需计算未知最优解的情况下，同时认证平均性能与尾部性能的改进。
en_tdlr: TAILOR guides LLM heuristic synthesis using the paired CVaR of cost differences between each candidate and an existing baseline on the same workload, where a negative paired CVaR certifies improvements in both average performance and tail optimality gap without ever computing the unknown optimum.
